# Chimera II Ecosystem Index

**Canonical project hub:** https://github.com/amerhwitat/ChimeraIIOS

## Scope

Chimera II OS is the canonical hub for the research program spanning the Koronos kernel, Spit Fire/Jasper boot chain, Spotnik networking, Aurora desktop and Mobile Edition, RegisterN, C8192/R8192 ISA research, emulation, toolchains, filesystems, Web UI and the 128D conceptual computing model.

## Mobile Edition

The Mobile Edition is maintained as a first-class Chimera target rather than a separate conceptual fork. Its architecture is portrait-first and ARM64-oriented, with shared APIs, HAL boundaries, package fabric, Aurora UI, terminal/files/browser applications, power management and compatibility layers.

## Web Edition

The Web Edition exposes selected Chimera functionality through the browser, including the Aurora surface, architecture explorer, terminal/IDE concepts, ISA/emulation visualization and documentation.

## Crypto safety boundary

Chimera II may integrate cryptographic primitives and legitimate wallet tooling, including key-to-address derivation, address validation, HD-wallet derivation and test vectors. It must not implement private-key recovery from arbitrary public addresses or unauthorized wallet-search functionality.

## Publication and federation

GitHub is the canonical public forge. Additional mirrors or open-source directories should be created only where the project owner has control or an explicit submission mechanism. Third-party projects must not be modified or represented as endorsing Chimera II without authorization.

## Relationship to the 128D framework

The conceptual model provides a research lens for relating geometry, time, perspective/observer, light/material response, events, objects, vectors, perception and higher-dimensional computational state. It is a research model and should be presented separately from experimentally validated hardware claims.
